top_signals.title: How China’s Intelligence Operations Target Tech
top_signals.summary: Former CIA counterintelligence analyst Peter Mattis tells Bloomberg This Weekend how China’s Ministry of State Security can use business and personal relationships to gather intelligence and potentially influence decision-making in strategically important industries. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mattis explains why technology executives can become valuable targets even without access to classified information and how AI is expanding the capabilities of Chinese intelligence operations. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kraken parent Payward posts 66% drop in Q3 adjusted EBITDA, plans US prediction markets and personal finance AI agent
top_signals.summary: Kraken parent Payward’s third-quarter adjusted EBITDA fell about two-thirds year over year to $60 million, while funded accounts grew 37%.

top_signals.title: U.S. Air Force captain arrested in Okinawa for alleged drunk driving
top_signals.summary: The arrest comes just a week after Tokyo and Washington agreed to measures aimed at preventing crimes by U.S. service members.
